name: Privacy
title: Privacy — Geek Informatic
description: Geek Informatic doesn’t collect student data: no accounts, no server, no trackers. Progress is saved only in your browser on your device, and one button erases it.
ogDescription: What the site stores, what it doesn’t collect, and how to erase your progress on this device.
lead: In short: Geek Informatic doesn’t know who you are. There are no accounts, no sign-up and no server that would collect student data.
none.2: Its own server: nothing is sent anywhere.
none.4: Requests to other servers: the fonts and the Blockly library (the block editor) are hosted on the site itself.
progress.p1: So that a game remembers where you stopped, the site saves progress in **localStorage**: a small memory built into the browser. The data stays on this device only and is never transmitted. If you open the site on another computer or in another browser, your progress won’t be there.
progress.1: **Drive the Robot!**: stars for the levels you have completed.
progress.2: **Galaxy Code**: stars for levels, the current level, your block programs for each level and the run speed.
progress.3: **Mars Rover Maze**: your block program, the speed and a mark that the algorithm has already passed the check.
progress.4: **{count.rebusy} {count.rebusy|rebus|rebuses}**: the numbers of the rebuses you have solved.
progress.7: **{count.sirnyky} matchstick {count.sirnyky|puzzle|puzzles}**: the numbers of the puzzles you have solved.
progress.5: **Cyber Shield Agents**: which missions are done, points, the mission and screen where you stopped, start and finish times and the key letters.
progress.6: **Home page**: a short summary of “done out of total” for each activity, used to show the progress bars on the cards.
kiber.p: The quest asks for a name and grade only for the agent ID card. They exist **only in the memory of the open page**: they are not saved to the device and not sent anywhere. After you reload the page you need to enter them again.
shared.p: Everyone who uses this same browser on this computer can see the progress and programs saved here. If you work on a school computer, clear the data with the button below at the end of the lesson.
clear.p: The button deletes all Geek Informatic progress in this browser: every activity and the summary on the home page. It can’t be undone.
clear.btn: Clear my data on this device
clear.noscript: The button works only with JavaScript turned on. Without it, clear the site data in your browser settings: find the section about sites or cookies and delete the data for the site `otianoleksij.github.io`.
host.p: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any host, GitHub may log technical data about visits (for example, the IP address) under its own rules. We don’t receive or control this data. More: [GitHub’s privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).
q.p: Have a question about privacy? Write in the [Issues section of the GitHub repository](https://github.com/otianoleksij/geek-informatic/issues).
confirm: Delete all Geek Informatic progress on this device? This can’t be undone.
progress.8: **Space Typing Trainer**: stars and best results (accuracy, speed, combo) for the finished levels, separately for the Ukrainian and English layouts.
progress.9: **Word Race**: the best place, speed and cups for each difficulty, separately for the Ukrainian and English versions.
